idea: AI companions replacing friends; AI-linked anxiety and distress

candidates.text: 67% of minors surveyed have reported using an AI chatbot or companion.
candidates.speaker_or_outlet: Thorn, press release on 'Youth Perspectives on Online Safety, 2025'
candidates.verified_how: Deck source: the Thorn slide in /home/user/poster/ai-safety-presentation/tools/slides_openweights.js (sources line and notes), and the entry thorn-pr-2026-chatbots in assets/research/openweights/rev2/deepfake.json (verified: true, screenshot captured). Live: opened the Thorn press release URL with WebFetch; the headline 'As AI becomes part of kids' response to online harm, new Thorn research finds children turning to chatbots for guidance after online sexual interactions' (July 28, 2026) and the 67% sentence both match.
candidates.why_it_fits: Hits 'two real friends' directly: two-thirds of minors using AI companions. Reads in about 2-3 s as a single line. The same release says 15% of minors who had an online sexual interaction sought guidance from an AI chatbot or companion (more than twice the 7% bullying rate); that sentence is too long for a phone read, so use it only in a longer card.
candidates.notes: Deck-first source. Minor (9-17) sample, US, from the deck's sourcing.

candidates.verified_how: Live: opened the page with WebFetch.
